description: Gives up a guest’s spot or their place on the waitlist, or takes back their ask to join, with the `id` and `token` join_event gave. A spot goes to the first person on the waitlist at once, so it can’t be taken back: to come after all, join again (join_event), at the end of the line. Works until the event starts (409 event_over after that, and 409 event_cancelled for a cancelled event). Leaving twice changes nothing. Ask the person before calling it.

id.description: a guest id ("gst_…"): from get_event for a host, or the one join_event gave the guest
id.title: minLength(1)

token.description: the guest’s token: `token` from join_event, or the `token` in their link (".../e/<slug>?guest=<id>&token=<token>")
token.title: minLength(10)

name: leave_event
title: Leave an event
